design_source.file: แอป [NEXY-IGNIS] ที่กำลังพัฒนา.docx

conflict.global_api_law: All mutating routes require secure session + CSRF, except OTAC request/verify.
conflict.owner_escalation_law: If OWNER session lost and suspicious lock active: manual owner recovery path required; emit security incident + audit trail; no hidden bypass.
conflict.consequence: A lost-session recovery mutation cannot simultaneously require an already-valid secure session unless an additional explicit recovery authority mechanism/exemption is specified.

current_implementation.behavior: No automatic OWNER access restoration; CSRF + idempotency + suspicious OWNER lock eligibility; revokes active sessions and emits security/audit evidence; no authenticated secure session required on lost-session path.
current_implementation.assessment: Satisfies owner escalation intent but conflicts with literal global mutation-session law.

prohibited_fixes: Do not silently exempt owner-recovery from Global API Law.
Do not require an impossible active session and claim lost-session recovery works.
required_authority_change: DOC-C must explicitly define the recovery authentication/exemption mechanism or precedence rule.
